sources.summary: The 3rd Adana Arch Fest, organized by the Adana Branch of the Chamber of Architects, will bring together architecture, design, art, and other cultural disciplines at the Adana Museum from October 15–17, 2026. Guided by Prof. Dr. Celal Abdi Güzer and curated by architect Nilüfer Kozikoğlu, this year’s festival takes “Fictive: Tales of Materials and Structures” as its central theme. Established as an annual platform for exchange around contemporary architectural practice, education, and culture, the Adana Arch Fest brings together leading voices from Turkey’s architectural scene alongside contributors from related fields.
